full_description:
Video Brief
Instrowest Rebranding Announcement

Context
In September, Instrowest will announce its rebranding across its social media channels. After 20 years in business, the brand is being updated, and we want customers, suppliers and other key stakeholders to know that while our look has changed, the company behind it has not.
Key message
After 20 years in business, we have updated our look, but we are the same company. Same values, same high standards, same way of working, now with an identity that better reflects who we are: experts in instrumentation.
About Instrowest
Instrowest is a company 100% dedicated to instrumentation for heavy industry, including mining, mineral processing, power generation, oil and gas, etc. We cover everything from instrumentation supply through to instrumentation services such as calibration, audits, shutdown support, plant commissioning, etc.
About the piece
We need a professional animated video showing the transition from the old Instrowest logo to the new one.
The key idea is that the old logo does not simply fade out. Its elements should break apart and update into their new versions until the new logo is fully formed. For example, the old gauge becomes the new dial rather than disappearing and being replaced.
The animation ends on the final logo lockup, with the tagline 100% Process Instrumentation.
Reference animation: we have put together a simple animation for reference. Please note this is just a reference for the sequence, not an example of the finished result we are after. In our reference the elements fade out, whereas we want them to visibly update into the new elements: IW - Reference Animation 
• Specifications: 
o Duration: Approximately 20 seconds
o Formats: 1920 x 1080 (16:9, landscape) and 1080 x 1080 (1:1, square)
o File format: MP4
o Audio: Music track included
Both formats are for LinkedIn and Facebook feeds. Please keep the logo within safe margins so nothing sits tight against the frame edges, and make sure the composition still reads well in the square crop.
Background: your choice. It can be a colour you feel works with the final logo. If you would prefer plant or site imagery, we can supply reference photos on request.
Music: a royalty-free track, cleared for commercial use. 
Deliverables
• Main video, approximately 20 seconds, in 16:9 and 1:1. MP4 only.
• A short 3 to 5 second clip of the dial animating on its own, in the same two formats.
Assets provided: 
• Old and new Instrowest logo

Meta Ads Specialist / Performance Marketer — Tamil Nadu | Placement-Focused Program

We’re Hiring a Performance Marketer Who Can Drive Admissions — Not Just Leads

We run a fast-growing IT placement and career guidance program in Tamil Nadu.

This is NOT a coding course or generic training program.

Our focus is helping:

- Experienced IT professionals struggling to get their next opportunity
- Experienced candidates looking for better career opportunities
- Career switchers trying to move into high-demand technology roles
- Candidates who need structured placement guidance and trusted referrals

We are now looking for an experienced Meta Ads Specialist / Performance Marketer who can help us scale this program through Facebook and Instagram.

 IMPORTANT: TAMIL NADU ONLY

We are specifically looking for a Tamil Nadu-based freelancer who:

- Understands the Tamil Nadu job market
- Can communicate comfortably in Tamil and English
- Understands Tamil audience behaviour and buying psychology
- Has experience targeting audiences within Tamil Nadu
- Can create campaigns specifically for Tamil-speaking audiences
- Understands the difference between generating inquiries and generating serious candidates

Our target audience is Tamil Nadu candidates only.

---

THE MAIN OBJECTIVE

We don't want thousands of cheap leads.

We want qualified candidates who are genuinely looking for placement/career opportunities and are willing to take the next step.

The funnel we care about is:

META ADS → QUALIFIED CANDIDATE → COUNSELLING → ENROLMENT → PLACEMENT OUTCOME

Your primary KPI will be qualified paid enrolments, not simply CPL.

---

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will own the Meta performance marketing strategy, including:

- Audience research and segmentation
- Tamil Nadu-specific targeting
- Career-switcher audience strategy
- Experienced IT professional targeting
- Campaign architecture
- Prospecting campaigns
- Retargeting campaigns
- Creative and copy testing
- A/B and multivariate testing
- Budget allocation and daily optimisation
- Lead quality optimisation
- Conversion funnel analysis
- CRM-based performance analysis
- Identifying why leads fail to convert
- Improving the journey from advertisement to paid enrolment

You should be comfortable making decisions based on actual conversion data, not vanity metrics.

---

OUR CORE AUDIENCE

We particularly want to reach:

Experienced Candidates

People who already have work experience but are struggling with:

- Getting shortlisted
- Finding better opportunities
- Career progression
- Switching technology domains
- Getting relevant interview opportunities
- Finding trusted placement support

Career Switchers

Candidates who want to transition into technology roles and need a structured path toward employment opportunities.

The marketer must understand how to distinguish these audiences and build different messaging and campaign segments rather than putting everyone into one audience.

---

PLACEMENT-FOCUSED POSITIONING

Again, this is important:

WE ARE NOT HIRING A MARKETER TO SELL A GENERIC CODING COURSE.

Our marketing needs to communicate the value of a placement-focused program, career guidance, interview support, and access to relevant opportunities/referrals.

You should be able to market based on career outcomes and candidate intent, while keeping all advertising claims accurate and compliant.

---

 PERFORMANCE-BASED COMPENSATION

We are moving toward a results-driven compensation model.

We don't want to pay simply because campaigns were launched or leads were generated.

We want incentives aligned with actual business results.

You can propose your preferred model, such as:

- CPA per confirmed enrolment
- Tiered CPA based on admission volume
- Percentage of revenue/tuition generated
- Milestone-based model
- Hybrid fixed + performance model

Your proposal should clearly explain:

What you expect → What you deliver → How you get paid

We will use our CRM to track lead quality, counselling progress and confirmed enrolments.

---

 WHAT WE WANT TO SEE FROM YOU

Please don't send a generic message saying:

"I am a Meta Ads expert with 5 years of experience."

Show us your numbers.

Include:

1. Previous Meta Ads case studies
2. Campaign budgets personally managed
3. Average CPL
4. Qualified-lead rate
5. Lead-to-sale/admission conversion rate
6. Cost per acquisition
7. ROAS/revenue generated where available
8. Experience with education, recruitment, career services, EdTech or similar businesses
9. Experience targeting Tamil Nadu / South Indian audiences
10. Your proposed performance-based compensation model

Also tell us exactly what you personally handled in your previous campaigns.

---

 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal person is:

✓ An experienced hands-on Meta Ads specialist
✓ Strong in performance marketing
✓ Experienced in lead-generation funnels
✓ Strong in audience segmentation
✓ Comfortable analysing CRM data
✓ Experienced with conversion optimisation
✓ Understands Tamil Nadu audiences
✓ Fluent in Tamil + English
✓ Comfortable with performance-based compensation
✓ Focused on revenue and admissions rather than vanity metrics

Tamil Nadu-based freelancers only.

If you have successfully converted advertising spend into qualified customers and measurable revenue, we want to talk to you.

ROLE

Meta Ads Specialist / Performance Marketer

Location: Tamil Nadu, India
Work: Remote
Target Market: Tamil Nadu
Language: Tamil + English
Industry: IT Career / Placement
Compensation: Performance-based / Conversion-linked

Apply with your portfolio, campaign results and proposed performance model.

full_description:
# Build & Operate a 150-Account Multi-Platform Content Distribution Network

## About the Project

Naundros Media Group LLC is building a large-scale content distribution operation for **6 content creators**, with **5 dedicated content channels/accounts per creator across 5 major social platforms**.

That means we are building and operating approximately:

**6 Creators × 5 Content Channels × 5 Platforms = 150 Accounts**

We are looking for experienced freelancers and/or a small remote team capable of helping us build, operate, automate, and scale this system.

This is **not a traditional social media management job**.

The goal is to create a repeatable content-production and distribution machine that can take existing creator content, identify the best moments, turn them into short-form content, package them appropriately for each platform, schedule them, monitor performance, and continuously improve based on analytics.

## The Platforms

The operation will cover:

* YouTube
* TikTok
* Instagram
* Facebook
* X

Each creator will have multiple channel/content identities designed around different niches, themes, formats, or audiences.

## The 6 Creators

We currently have six creators whose existing content can be repurposed into a large volume of short-form content.

A major advantage of this project is that **we already have a substantial content library**.

The objective is to systematically turn that existing content into thousands of pieces of distributable media rather than constantly needing to create everything from scratch.

---

# What We Need Help With

We are looking for freelancers who can handle one or more of the following areas.

### 1. Short-Form Video Editing

Turn long-form creator content into engaging:

* YouTube Shorts
* TikToks
* Instagram Reels
* Facebook Reels
* X video content

Responsibilities may include:

* Finding strong moments
* Identifying hooks
* Cutting clips
* Removing dead space
* Captions/subtitles
* Zooms and reframing
* Punch-in effects
* Sound effects when appropriate
* Music when appropriate
* Vertical 9:16 formatting
* Platform-specific formatting
* Strong comedic/dramatic pacing
* Creating multiple variations from the same source

We want editors who understand **retention**, not simply people who know how to cut video.

---

### 2. Titles, Captions & Copy

Create platform-appropriate:

* Titles
* Captions
* Descriptions
* Hooks
* Hashtags
* Keywords
* Calls to action

Copy should be adapted to each platform rather than blindly duplicated everywhere.

---

### 3. Scheduling & Publishing

We need people who can reliably manage large-scale publishing.

Responsibilities include:

* Uploading content
* Scheduling posts
* Maintaining publishing calendars
* Correctly assigning content to accounts
* Maintaining metadata
* Checking links
* Managing playlists/categories where applicable
* Confirming scheduled posts
* Tracking published content

Accuracy is extremely important.

With 150 accounts, one misplaced upload can become a very expensive mistake.

---

### 4. Graphics & Thumbnails

Create reusable:

* YouTube thumbnails
* Channel branding
* Profile graphics
* Social graphics
* Templates
* Promotional assets

We want a system of templates that allows us to maintain consistent branding while producing assets quickly.

---

### 5. Analytics & Growth

Analyze performance across the network.

Track things such as:

* Views
* Watch time
* Retention
* Engagement
* Shares
* Likes
* Comments
* Subscribers/followers
* Posting frequency
* Best-performing topics
* Best-performing hooks
* Best-performing formats
* Best-performing creators
* Best-performing channels

The goal isn't simply to report numbers.

We want actionable conclusions such as:

**"This type of hook is outperforming the others."**

**"This creator's clips perform better at this length."**

**"This topic should be produced more frequently."**

**"This format should be discontinued."**

The analytics need to feed directly back into the production process.

---

### 6. Content Research

Identify:

* Strong moments
* Recurring themes
* Trends
* Topics
* Viral formats
* Potential clip ideas
* Content gaps
* Opportunities for new channel concepts

---

### 7. Content Operations

This is one of the most important areas.

We need someone capable of keeping the entire production pipeline organized.

For example:

**Raw Creator Content**

↓

**Content Selection**

↓

**Editing**

↓

**Captions/Copy**

↓

**QA**

↓

**Scheduling**

↓

**Publishing**

↓

**Analytics**

↓

**Optimization**

The Operations person should make sure content doesn't get lost somewhere in the pipeline.

---

### 8. Quality Control

Before publishing, verify:

* Correct creator
* Correct channel
* Correct platform
* Correct video
* Correct aspect ratio
* Correct captions
* Correct title
* Correct description
* Correct thumbnail
* Audio quality
* No obvious editing mistakes
* No accidental private information
* No copyright/problematic material
* Correct scheduling date/time

---

# What We Are Looking For

You do **not** necessarily need to be able to perform every task above.

We are open to:

### Individual specialists

For example:

* Video editor
* Social media manager
* Graphic designer
* Analytics specialist
* Content researcher
* Operations VA

### OR

### Small teams/agencies

A small team that can handle multiple parts of the operation is welcome to apply.

If you can provide **editing + publishing + analytics**, for example, that is extremely valuable.

---

# Important: This Is a Long-Term Scaling Project

We are not looking for someone to make 10 posts and disappear.

The goal is to develop a **repeatable system that can scale from dozens of accounts to approximately 150 accounts.**

We want people who think in terms of:

* Systems
* SOPs
* Automation
* Templates
* Batch production
* Efficiency
* Quality control
* Analytics
* Scalability

If you have experience managing large content libraries or multi-account social media operations, that is a major advantage.

---

# Tools

We are open to recommendations, but our workflow may involve tools such as:

* CapCut
* OpusClip
* YouTube Studio
* Meta Business Suite
* TikTok
* X
* Scheduling platforms
* Google Drive
* Google Sheets
* Notion
* AI-assisted editing/writing tools

We are particularly interested in freelancers who are comfortable incorporating **AI and automation into high-volume content production** without sacrificing quality.

---

# How We Want to Work

We want to build the system **before trying to maximize volume**.

The successful freelancer/team will help us establish:

1. Folder structure
2. Naming conventions
3. Content database
4. Editing standards
5. Branding templates
6. Publishing standards
7. QA checklist
8. Scheduling workflow
9. Analytics dashboard
10. SOPs for repeating the process

Once the system is proven, we will scale it across the creator network.

---

# Compensation

We are open to discussing:

* Per-video rates
* Per-account rates
* Weekly rates
* Monthly retainers
* Project-based pricing
* Team/agency pricing

Please provide your preferred pricing model and explain what is included.

**Do not assume that all 150 accounts must be managed manually by one person.**

We are specifically interested in efficient systems, batching, automation, and delegation.

---

# Application Instructions

Please include:

### 1. Your specialty

Tell us exactly what you do best.

### 2. Your experience

Have you worked with:

* YouTube
* TikTok
* Instagram
* Facebook
* X
* Short-form content
* Multi-account management
* High-volume content production?

### 3. Portfolio

Provide relevant examples.

For editors, please provide actual short-form examples.

### 4. Capacity

Tell us approximately how much content you can realistically handle per week.

### 5. Pricing

Give us your preferred pricing model and approximate rates.

### 6. Team

If you are an agency/team, tell us:

* Number of people
* Roles
* Who would manage our account
* Your workflow
* Your maximum capacity

### 7. Systems

Tell us about any systems, automation, AI tools, or SOPs you have used to manage high-volume content.

### 8. Scaling

Most importantly:

**How would YOU design a workflow capable of supporting 6 creators, 5 content channels per creator, and 5 platforms?**

We are very interested in your thinking here.

---

# The Ideal Partner

The ideal candidate isn't simply someone who says:

**"I can post on social media."**

We are looking for someone who says:

**"Give me the content library and the system, and I'll help turn it into a scalable distribution operation."**

If you are excited by building a content machine rather than managing a handful of social posts, we'd like to hear from you.

**This project has significant potential for long-term work as the network grows.**
